dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: How many languages do you speak?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒɪz duː juː ˈspiːk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh! Do you speak Thai, too?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ! duː juː ˈspiːk ˈtaɪ, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, a little. But not very well!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ə ˈlɪtəl. bʌt ˈnɑːt ˈvɛri ˈwɛl!
